_comment: AS/400 library descriptions used by the DASD browser. Entries may be expanded or corrected as additional IBM documentation and recovered systems are studied.

#CGULIB.description: IBM System/36 Environment compatibility library; IBM lists it among the special System/36 # libraries. Exact CGU component purpose is still being researched.

#DBULIB.description: Recovered library containing DBU-named objects and source. Exact product or application ownership has not yet been identified.

#DFULIB.description: IBM System/36 Environment Data File Utility compatibility library.

#DSULIB.description: IBM System/36 Environment compatibility library. Exact DSU component expansion is still being researched.

#LIBRARY.description: System/36 Environment library created by the system and used with QSSP for System/36-compatible files and procedures.

#SDALIB.description: IBM System/36 Environment Screen Design Aid compatibility library.

#SEULIB.description: IBM System/36 Environment Source Entry Utility compatibility library.

QDOC.description: QDLS/document-library backing library. Folder and document objects are represented internally as *FLR and *DOC DLOs; this is not a source library.

QDSNX.description: IBM-supplied user-data library used for transferring files between the AS/400 and an IBM mainframe.

QGPL.description: General Purpose Library. IBM-supplied home for miscellaneous system/user objects and the default current library when a job has no explicit current library.

QHLPSYS.description: System help library containing IBM online-help text and related information.

QIWS.description: PC Support/400 host/server library; later OS/400 documentation identifies it as the Host Servers option. It supports PC connectivity functions such as shared folders and file transfer.

QIWS2D.description: Client Access/400 for OS/2 DBCS support library.

QIWS2S.description: Client Access/400 for OS/2 SBCS support library.

QIWSFD.description: Client Access/400 for DOS support library paired with QIWSFS. The D suffix appears to identify the DBCS variant; exact wording is still being verified.

QIWSFS.description: Client Access/400 for DOS SBCS support library.

QIWSPD.description: Client Access/400 Extended DOS DBCS support library.

QIWSPS.description: Client Access/400 Extended DOS SBCS support library.

QIWSTL.description: PC Support/Client Access tools library; IBM installation tables map the QIWSTOOL component to library QIWSTL.

QMGU.description: OS/400 System/36 and System/38 Migration library (operating-system migration support).

QMU400.description: OS/400 System/36 Migration Assistant library (OS/400 option 11 in later licensed-program listings).

QPDA.description: IBM application-development tooling library used by PDM and related development functions.

QPFRDATA.description: IBM-supplied performance-data library used to store performance monitor and Performance Tools collection data.

QQALIB.description: IBM Q & A support/model-data library; IBM command documentation identifies QAQA model database files here.

QRPG.description: RPG/400 licensed-program library containing compiler and support objects.

QSDE.description: Recovered IBM-style library containing QAEB-named files. Exact product/component purpose has not yet been identified.

QSPL.description: Spooling Library; contains files and internal objects supporting printer output and spooled files.

QSSP.description: OS/400 System/36 Environment library. SSP means System Support Program, the System/36 operating environment emulated by OS/400.

QSYS.description: Primary OS/400 system library containing operating-system commands, programs, device descriptions, and other core system objects.

QTEMP.description: Private per-job temporary library. It is created for each job and deleted, along with its objects, when that job ends.

QUSRSYS.description: IBM-supplied system library for user-related and system-maintained data such as message queues and distribution information.
